set.signal: H1 2026 (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026, consolidated, K-IFRS, reviewed by Daejoo Accounting): revenue KRW 720,170M vs KRW 493,909M in H1 2025 (+46% as printed); gross profit KRW 179,776M; operating profit KRW 144,285M vs KRW 89,754M (+61% as printed); net income KRW 110,152M vs KRW 69,670M (+58% as printed); basic EPS KRW 1,501 vs 1,033. Q2 alone: revenue KRW 379,888M (vs KRW 241,419M a year ago), operating profit KRW 77,064M (vs KRW 42,070M a year ago), net income KRW 59,709M. FY2025 reference: revenue KRW 1,088,025M / OP KRW 204,725M. MIX: own-manufactured PCB 95.92% (KRW 690,758M), traded PCB 4.08% (KRW 29,412M); exports >97% of sales. Average export selling price KRW 4,875,174/m2 vs KRW 4,477,422 for FY2025 and KRW 3,739,531 for FY2024, attributed by the filing to a higher share of high-value products. GEOGRAPHY (consolidated, by customer location): Thailand KRW 209,334M, Mexico KRW 133,668M, Taiwan KRW 107,653M, other countries KRW 248,069M, Korea KRW 21,445M. Parent (separate) revenue KRW 584,593M / OP KRW 100,771M; China subsidiary ISU Petasys Asia (Hunan plant) revenue KRW 165,490M / net income KRW 26,141M in H1. Balance sheet at 2026-06-30: cash KRW 144,347M plus KRW 89,792M short-term deposits; receivables KRW 343,275M (up from KRW 214,127M at 2025-12-31); inventories KRW 374,429M (up from KRW 298,792M); total borrowings KRW 269,229M; debt-to-equity 70.6%; net debt ratio 3.6% (net cash at year-end 2025). Operating cash flow was NEGATIVE KRW 49,616M (vs +KRW 49,495M) because receivables grew KRW 117,322M and inventories KRW 78,128M on the sales ramp; PP&E purchases KRW 79,059M (vs KRW 50,789M). Korea Ratings raised the corporate rating to BBB+ / stable on 2026-05-12 (from BBB / positive on 2025-11-26). Filing narrative: demand expanded sharply across AI accelerators, switches and servers; Plant 4 in full mass production with automation of the older plants; 2026 growth expected from front-end demand, the Plant 5 expansion effect and production-site optimisation across the China and Thailand entities.

items.signal_prefix: Orders and customers (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026

set.signal: Orders and customers (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026, as of 2026-06-30): H1 2026 NEW ORDERS KRW 836,195M (147,923 m2) vs KRW 571,375M delivered (117,064 m2); ORDER BACKLOG KRW 622,180M (109,714 m2) at 2026-06-30. CUSTOMER CONCENTRATION: one customer (anonymised customer A) is 40.1% of consolidated H1 revenue (KRW 288,666M, up from KRW 208,600M / 42.2% a year ago); the parent's separate-books major-customer note lists A KRW 274,762M, B KRW 60,679M (vs KRW 23,954M a year earlier) and C KRW 39,575M, together 57.4% of parent revenue (the note says two customers exceeded 10%). Filing states products go mainly to global big-tech companies - data-center, AI and network-equipment makers - sold direct (Americas direct supply), ~60-day payment after shipment. Hyperscale server market: of the CSPs holding >60% of the global data-center market the company has secured 'G' and 'M' as customers and is in talks with 'A' for new entry. AI accelerators: 'G' and 'N' are the main customers, both are expected to have the company participate in and mass-produce their NEXT-GENERATION models, and new AI-accelerator customers are being pursued, so AI-accelerator revenue is expected to keep expanding; the filing notes that 'N' dominates GPUs while 'A' and other big techs accelerate in-house AI ASICs (chiplet, 2.5D/3D packaging, HBM) - the structural driver of ultra-multilayer MLB demand. Networking: 800G switch MASS PRODUCTION has started, with switch/router bandwidth moving 400G to 800G to 1.6T. Trade receivables rose to KRW 328,977M (99.49% under 6 months).

items.signal_prefix: Capacity and capex (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026):

set.signal: Capacity and capex (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026): Daegu plant capacity 119 thousand m2 in H1 2026 (vs 228k m2 for FY2025 and 200k for FY2024), production 115 thousand m2 (vs 214k for all of FY2025), UTILISATION 96.8% (3,642 of 3,763 available hours; 21.5 hours/day, 175 working days) - effectively full. CAPEX PROGRAMME KRW 400,000M total: (1) new plant construction and capacity expansion (Plant 5) KRW 352,300M over 2025-2028, KRW 109,712M spent and KRW 242,588M remaining; (2) capacity expansion and replacement of aged equipment KRW 47,700M in 2025, fully spent. KRW 157,412M of the KRW 282,526M raised in the 2025-04-17 rights offering (10,162,800 shares at KRW 27,800) had been deployed by 2026-06-30 for Plants 1-4 expansion, Plant 5 and capacity additions; the remainder is to be spent per the 2025-04-07 prospectus. Construction-in-progress KRW 133,166M at 2026-06-30; machinery net book value rose to KRW 126,177M from KRW 88,919M at year-end (KRW 43,737M transferred from CIP in H1); H1 PP&E additions KRW 86,299M. Construction contract with related party Isu Construction for the new plant has an unbilled balance of KRW 123,170M. Funding: board approved a new KDB facility loan on 2026-05-11 (long-term borrowings +KRW 40,000M in H1); government subsidies of KRW 40,000M (reshoring-company subsidy, conditions run to 2031-05) and KRW 3,000M (regional investment, to 2030-09) support the domestic plant build. Board registered a new Guji plant business site on 2026-02-20. Filing: Plant 4 in full mass production; Plant 5 staged expansion under way to build a multi-lamination high-value production system; China (Hunan) and Thailand entities being used to optimise production sites by product group, shorten lead times and cut cost. Inventories KRW 374,429M (25.5% of assets; work-in-process KRW 197,692M) with KRW 20,389M valuation allowance.
